name: alma
description: What ALMA's calibrated data carry besides the sky, as measured on the 100 MADIV-16 windows (research/noise_realism): radiometer noise following Tsys with the atmosphere's lines and a receiver ripple, Hanning-correlated native channels, each antenna's noise ripple, and on bright sources the antenna gains, slow and fast atmospheric phase and baseline errors that calibration leaves.

provenance.data: MADIV-16, 100 windows of ALMA cycle 11 calibrated data
provenance.notes: Radiometer: receiver temperatures from ALMA's SYSCAL Tsys on the 12 m windows (bands 1, 3-7; bands 8-10 earlier estimates), Ruze efficiency fitted to the efficiency the windows' noise and Tsys imply, as of #481. Channel correlation: Hanning's theoretical 2/3 and 1/6. Receiver ripple: SYSCAL Tsys against the measured channel profiles. Antenna ripple: median of the 73 windows wider than 1 GHz. Baseline errors: median of the 13 bright windows where they are measurable (amplitude; phase rounded). Slow phase, gains: early fits on 3 bright windows. Fast phase: no saved fit reproduces it.
